answer: Latency-Weighted Action Delay.** Each new agent identity carries a mandatory confirmation delay before its actions count toward shared pools; the delay grows with the number of identities sharing hardware, timing, or network origin, detected via correlation of request patterns. A fable of “one agent, one voice” becomes costly when an attacker must stagger activations across weeks to avoid correlated-delay clustering. The signal separating honest from synthetic agents is temporal dispersion. A genuine oasis of independent operators pays near-zero delay;
